Organizer: Rosa"},{"spec_id":"spec_0417","text":"Subject: Request for Attendance: Thistle Migration Brainstorming Session

Dear Committee Members,

On behalf of the Lanternbridge Middle School PTO Executive Board, I am writing to request your attendance at a brainstorming session concerning the Thistle migration, scheduled for Thursday from 7:00 to 7:45 PM in the school library (a video link will be circulated for those unable to attend in person).

As you are aware, the Board has approved in principle the transition of our volunteer records, sign-up sheets, and communications to the new platform. The purpose of this session is to gather ideas and perspectives regarding the migration in general terms, so that the Board may take your input into account as planning proceeds.

The following members are requested to attend:
- Xavier Kowalczyk
- Olu Hollander
- Keiko Ishikawa
- Femi Bakshi
- Sofia Jaramillo
- Grace Haddad
- Two representatives from the Room Parent Coordinators group

In preparation, members may wish to reflect upon their experiences with the current system and any thoughts they may have regarding the new one. No formal materials will be distributed in advance, and no decisions are expected to be taken at this session; the Board will review all contributions at its next regular meeting.

Should you be unable to attend, you are welcome to submit your thoughts to me in writing by Wednesday evening, and they will be given equal consideration.

Kindly confirm your attendance at your earliest convenience so that seating and refreshments can be arranged accordingly.

With appreciation for your continued service to our school community,

Hector
Secretary, Lanternbridge Middle School PTO"},{"spec_id":"spec_0418","text":"Cleo — 15 min sync per Form 7B scheduling protocol, Tues 10:00!!! Thanks!!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0419","text":"Vendor demo – contract tooling
